# Issue review

## Dump integrity

The issue belongs to another repository and was read directly through

## Validation and sources

### Remote state

- `dig +noall +answer go.octolab.org` returned the CNAME
  `octomation.github.io` and GitHub Pages addresses. DNS already targets GitHub.
- `GET /repos/octomation/vanity/pages` returned `build_type: workflow`,
  `cname: null`, `https_enforced: true`, and
  `html_url: https://octomation.github.io/vanity/`.
- `curl -Iv https://go.octolab.org` failed hostname verification: the presented
  certificate covers `*.github.io`, not the vanity domain.
- The saved publication at `https://octomation.github.io/vanity/` returned valid
  metadata for `/`, `/toolkit/cli`, and `/toolkit/config`, pointing to
  `octolab/pkg`, `octolab/cli`, and `octolab/config` respectively.
- `GET /repos/octomation/vanity/actions/workflows` reported delivery workflow
  65692825 as `disabled_inactivity`. Its latest recorded run, 22538681747,
  failed. Logs expired (HTTP 410), but check run 65290386886 annotations still
  report `could not read Username for 'https://github.com': terminal prompts disabled`
  and Git exit 128 during checkout.
- Repository Actions secrets returned `total_count: 0`. Organization Actions
  secrets were inaccessible to the current token; inherited secret availability
  is unverified. Several registered repositories are private.
- `PUT /repos/octomation/vanity/pages` with `cname=go.octolab.org` was rejected
  with HTTP 400: `You must verify your domain go.octolab.org before being able
  to use it.` A subsequent GET confirmed that `cname` remained null.
- Existing TXT records were not found at either
  `_github-pages-challenge-octomation.go.octolab.org` or
  `_github-pages-challenge-octomation.octolab.org`. The user will add DNS TXT;
  GitHub must first generate its value in the organization's Pages settings.

### Local checks

- Built using the checksum-verified Maintainer `v0.1.0-rc11` Darwin arm64 release
  and Go 1.27.1. With a fresh `GOMODCACHE` and `GOTOOLCHAIN=local`, `make` produced
  **30 module roots and 369 package pages**. The module cache contained no files.
- `make verify` passed for all 369 pages. Nested tools and sandbox modules were
  excluded from their parent modules' package lists.
- A copied output tree with CLI metadata pointing at the root repository was
  rejected. Removing the CLI root page was also rejected.
- A simulated `gh` failure caused `make` to fail, left every existing output
  file byte-for-byte unchanged, and removed the temporary build directory.
- Calling the repository's `Taskfile verify` from a submodule directory passed.
- `actionlint` 1.7.12, `bash -n` for Taskfile/core scripts, and `git diff --check`
  passed after corrections.
- `make check` failed at normal TLS verification, as expected while Pages has
  no custom domain. A separate fresh-cache `GOPROXY=direct` download attempt
  failed with the same hostname error for all four requested versions:
  `go.octolab.org@v0.12.0`, `go.octolab.org@v0.12.2`,
  `go.octolab.org/toolkit/cli@v0.6.3`, and
  `go.octolab.org/toolkit/config@v0.0.4`. TLS and checksum verification stayed on.

### Not verified

No new artifact was deployed. The GitHub-hosted Ubuntu build and Linux release
binary were not executed locally. Successful direct downloads, certificate
issuance, and the consuming CI jobs remain unverified. Indexit's workflows
currently select `1.x` and `1.26.x`; the recovery checks must pass on both after
HTTPS is restored. The current Actions token's cross-repository access cannot
be established from secret names or the expired logs.

## Recommendations

1. In the organization's Pages settings, add `go.octolab.org`, obtain the TXT
   challenge, publish it, and complete verification. Keep the TXT record.
2. Set the repository's Pages custom domain to `go.octolab.org`, wait for the
   trusted certificate, and verify HTTPS enforcement. The existing artifact
   already contains the three discovery endpoints needed by indexit.
3. Restore an Actions `DEPENDABOT_TOKEN` with read access to all registered
   repositories. Check organization-secret visibility as well as permissions.
4. Review the local recovery changes before committing or publishing:
   `bin/lib/core/modules.bash:1` enumerates all registry entries, rejects missing
   or mismatched checkouts, and avoids dependency graph resolution;
   `bin/lib/core/compile.bash:3` validates a temporary build before replacing
   output; `bin/verify.py:45` checks the expected repository for each prefix.
   `.github/workflows/cd.urls.yml:40` checks credentials, installs a fixed
   Maintainer release, requires the custom domain, and validates before upload.
   `go.work:1` selects the tested toolchain; the workspace's active module list
   no longer selects published modules.
5. After review, re-enable delivery and deploy the reviewed changes. Run
   `make check` (`bin/lib/core/check.bash:1`) on Go 1.x and 1.26.x, then rerun
   indexit's dependency installation and Go cache warmup jobs. Check the full
   new catalog with `python3 bin/verify.py --url https://go.octolab.org`.
